policy: Quantitative social-science work is controlled by research question, estimand, identification, diagnostics, robustness, transparent code, and bounded writing. External econometrics and de-AIGC skills provide patterns, but they do not replace the local route, citation, data, figure, writing, or reproducibility gates.

adopted_as: AER identification-first sequence before manuscript prose
modern causal design families and referee-facing diagnostics
full empirical analysis loop for Python, R, and Stata style projects
robustness, heterogeneity, mechanism, placebo, and sensitivity matrix
academic de-AI writing audit as claim-preserving surface cleanup
AER skills decision tree for RCT, RDD, DID, IV, shift-share, SCM, mechanism, and replication design choice
Stata do-file ecosystem conventions including master runner, package installer, diagnostics, logs, and table/figure exports
academic humanization usage pattern: detect first, rewrite second, second-pass audit, no detector-bypass promise
not_adopted: bulk installing all external empirical or humanizer skills into runtime
using AER or economics top-5 standards as default for all social-science papers
using StatsPAI or any DSL as a black box without explicit audit artifacts
guaranteeing detector bypass or editing to hide unreviewed AI-generated scholarship
copying external templates as verified methods or references
treating a de-AIGC score or detector number as the formal quality target
using Stata package lists without project-specific design, data, and replication checks

adoption_options.label: Directly install AER, StatsPAI, and humanizer skills
adoption_options.description: Direct installation would expose many overlapping writing and routing triggers, making Codex choose between duplicate humanization, writing, and quant skills.
strengths: keeps upstream language close to source
risks: imports economics top-5 conventions as too broad a default
can make detector-oriented language look like a separate objective

adoption_options.label: Adapt into local empirical quant contract
adoption_options.description: Encode useful upstream methods as a local schema, catalog, validator, quant skill, route rule, and quality gate while preserving research-autopilot as the only router.
strengths: keeps identification, robustness, writing, figures, and replication under one local chain
makes causal method choice and diagnostics reviewable
lets English AER patterns remain optional instead of universal
prevents humanization from changing facts, claims, citations, or uncertainty
risks: requires validator upkeep when new methods are added
does not expose every external helper command immediately

adoption_options.label: Keep StatsPAI as optional future runtime
adoption_options.description: StatsPAI may be useful for fast exploratory causal workflows, but it needs separate local installation, API smoke tests, and result audit before becoming a default tool.
strengths: could speed up exploratory model routing
self-describing function API may help agent use
risks: DSL output can hide modeling decisions
local projects still need transparent scripts for reviewers and collaborators
package version drift can change results

adoption_options.label: Leave quant analysis as a short runtime skill
adoption_options.description: The existing short quant-analysis skill names minimum inputs but does not encode modern identification, diagnostics, robustness, or replication contracts.
risks: robustness and replication are easy to postpone
writing and figure outputs can drift away from the empirical design

workflow_modes.label: 量化研究问题和估计目标澄清
required_steps: declare whether the task is descriptive, predictive, associational, or causal
state the estimand or the statistic before selecting a model
record sample, time window, unit, treatment, outcome, controls, and clustering level
ask for missing design information before causal wording

workflow_modes.label: 识别策略审计
required_steps: select a design family from design_families
write the identifying assumption in one plain sentence
run the design family's required diagnostics before prose polishing
mark old defaults such as naive TWFE, first-stage F > 10, or high-order RDD polynomials as red flags

use the design decision tree before model selection: randomized assignment, threshold, timing shock, instrument, shift-share exposure, matched observables, synthetic control, or non-causal descriptive boundary
for staggered DID, reject naive TWFE as the only estimator and require modern cohort, imputation, or interaction-weighted checks
for weak IV risk, require weak-IV robust inference or downgrade the causal claim
for shift-share designs, declare whether identification comes from exogenous shares or exogenous shocks and audit Rotemberg weights or shock-level inference

workflow_modes.label: 完整实证分析链
required_steps: clean data and record merge validation
construct variables and declare transformations
run descriptives and diagnostic checks
estimate the selected model family
run robustness, heterogeneity, mechanism, and sensitivity checks
produce figure, table, interpretation, and reproducibility artifacts
if Stata is used, create or inspect a master do-file pipeline with relative paths, package installation, logs, deterministic seeds, and table/figure output folders
store Stata outputs beside scripts and logs so the reviewer can trace every table or figure back to a command file

workflow_modes.label: 稳健性和敏感性矩阵
required_steps: write the threat model before adding checks
rank robustness checks by the threats they answer
keep main-text robustness compact and move deep variants to appendix
separate failed robustness from optional polish

workflow_modes.label: 量化表图和结果解释
required_steps: make one claim per table or figure
state estimator, sample, N, standard error or confidence interval structure
keep coefficient order, stars, notes, and precision consistent
route formal figures through scientific_figure_workflow and figure_table_consistency_checked

workflow_modes.label: 复现包预审
required_steps: write README before final packaging
list every dataset, script, output table, and output figure
record software versions and rerun order
separate restricted data instructions from public replication artifacts

workflow_modes.label: 学术去模板化表层审计
required_steps: diagnose empty rhetoric, mechanical transitions, inflated novelty, vague attribution, and rhythm uniformity
preserve claims, data, citations, variables, uncertainty, and limitations
apply Chinese, English, or bilingual academic surface rules according to target_language
run a second audit and report remaining surface risks without promising detector bypass
choose detect-only or rewrite mode before editing
for Chinese academic prose, use the five-step loop: locate, classify, rewrite, five-dimension self-check, second-pass review
for English academic prose, use severity tiers for vague attribution, inflated novelty, causal overclaiming, generic conclusions, formulaic transitions, and rhythm uniformity
treat detector scores as external signals only; the local acceptance target is evidence-faithful, authorial academic prose

design_families.label: 描述或相关研究
design_families.use_when: The goal is to summarize distributions, associations, group differences, or predictive patterns without causal claims.
preferred_estimators: descriptive statistics
group comparison
correlation
OLS or GLM as association model
red_flags: using causal verbs such as effect or impact without a design
turning statistical significance into substantive importance
omitting sample weights when the survey design requires them

design_families.label: 面板固定效应
design_families.use_when: Repeated units over time allow within-unit comparison, but treatment timing or assignment is not enough for a stronger design by itself.
preferred_estimators: two-way fixed effects for association or carefully bounded causal designs
high-dimensional fixed effects
first difference when justified by the data structure
red_flags: unbalanced panel ignored without explanation
standard errors clustered at the wrong level
dynamic panel bias ignored when lagged dependent variables are used

design_families.label: 双重差分和事件研究
design_families.use_when: Treatment status changes over time for treated and comparison units, and the central assumption is counterfactual trend comparability.
preferred_estimators: canonical 2x2 DID for single treatment date
Callaway-Sant'Anna group-time ATT for staggered adoption
Sun-Abraham event study for staggered adoption
Borusyak-Jaravel-Spiess imputation when appropriate
HonestDID sensitivity when pre-trend concerns remain
red_flags: naive TWFE as the only estimator under staggered treatment
pre-trend test treated as proof rather than evidence
no event-time support or anticipation check

design_families.label: 工具变量
design_families.use_when: A plausibly exogenous instrument shifts the endogenous regressor but should not affect the outcome except through that regressor.
preferred_estimators: 2SLS with transparent first stage
LIML or GMM when justified
Anderson-Rubin or weak-IV robust confidence sets when instruments are weak
red_flags: defending exclusion only by adding controls
first-stage F > 10 used as sufficient proof in clustered modern settings
reduced form omitted from the evidence chain

design_families.label: 断点回归
design_families.use_when: Treatment assignment changes sharply or fuzzily at a threshold in a running variable.
preferred_estimators: local linear RD with MSE-optimal bandwidth
robust bias-corrected confidence intervals
donut RD when bunching near cutoff is plausible
fuzzy RD when treatment compliance is imperfect
red_flags: high-order global polynomial
no density or manipulation test
no covariate continuity check
selective bandwidth reporting

design_families.label: 匹配、加权和协变量平衡
design_families.use_when: The design relies on observed confounder adjustment through matching, propensity scores, inverse probability weighting, or entropy balancing.
preferred_estimators: propensity-score matching
inverse probability weighting
entropy balancing
doubly robust estimators when assumptions support them
red_flags: post-treatment controls used in balance adjustment
no common support or overlap plot
causal language without unconfoundedness discussion

design_families.label: 合成控制和合成双重差分
design_families.use_when: A small number of treated aggregate units require a transparent comparison built from weighted controls.
preferred_estimators: classic synthetic control
synthetic difference-in-differences
generalized synthetic control when panel structure supports it
red_flags: poor pre-treatment fit hidden by visual scale
donor pool includes contaminated controls
no placebo or permutation inference

design_families.label: 机器学习辅助因果估计
design_families.use_when: The project uses DML, causal forests, meta-learners, or text-based causal features while still making a causal claim.
preferred_estimators: double machine learning
causal forest
meta-learners
text causal models only with transparent feature construction
red_flags: benchmark performance substituted for identification
text features used without measurement validity review
black-box heterogeneity presented as mechanism

design_families.label: Shift-share 和 Bartik 设计
design_families.use_when: Units have different baseline exposure shares and external shocks generate plausibly exogenous variation in treatment intensity.
preferred_estimators: Bartik or shift-share IV with transparent share and shock construction
Rotemberg weight audit when identification relies on exposure shares
shock-level inference when identification relies on exogenous shocks
leave-one-out or industry-region exclusion checks when appropriate
red_flags: current or post-treatment shares used as baseline exposure
top Rotemberg weights hidden or dominated by a few shocks
shock exogeneity asserted without source and timing evidence
ordinary unit-level standard errors used when shock-level inference is required

design_families.label: 三重差分 DDD
design_families.use_when: A third comparison dimension can remove residual confounding that ordinary DID cannot credibly handle.
preferred_estimators: DDD with transparent three-way interaction interpretation
event-study DDD when timing and support allow
modern staggered-DID extension when treatment adoption is staggered
red_flags: third difference dimension chosen after seeing results
baseline differences across the third dimension left unexplained
interaction coefficient interpreted without reconstructing the comparison cells
support missing for one of the treatment-time-dimension cells

design_families.label: 随机实验和田野实验
design_families.use_when: Treatment assignment is randomized, lottery-based, or experimentally manipulated with a pre-specified design.
preferred_estimators: intention-to-treat estimate
treatment-on-the-treated with compliance design when justified
randomization inference
multiple-hypothesis adjusted families
red_flags: differential attrition ignored
unregistered outcome switching hidden
cluster randomization analyzed as individual randomization
multiple outcomes reported without adjustment or family definition

design_families.label: 连续处理、剂量反应和强度效应
design_families.use_when: The treatment varies by intensity, duration, dose, or exposure level rather than a simple treated/control indicator.
preferred_estimators: dose-response curve with transparent functional form
generalized propensity score or weighting when assumptions support it
spline or binning sensitivity
marginal effect plots with uncertainty intervals
red_flags: linear dose effect assumed without support
extreme doses drive the conclusion
post-treatment variables used as dose controls
marginal effects plotted without uncertainty or support range

design_families.label: 机制、中介、分布效应和异质性
design_families.use_when: The project needs to explain channels, subgroup variation, distributional change, CATE, or quantile effects after the main design is established.
preferred_estimators: theory-predicted heterogeneity analysis
mechanism outcomes and alternative-channel tests
causal mediation only when sequential assumptions are defendable
quantile or distributional treatment effects
CATE or causal forest as exploratory heterogeneity with validation
red_flags: post-treatment mediator treated as if randomly assigned
subgroups selected only because they are significant
heterogeneity presented as mechanism
black-box CATE described as theory without validation

diagnostics.label: 数据清洗与合并完整性
diagnostics.purpose: Prevent silent sample changes, duplicate units, many-to-many merge errors, and unstable panel definitions.
checks: row counts before and after each merge
diagnostics.failure_action: Stop modeling and produce a data-cleaning blocker report.

diagnostics.label: 缺失、异常值和平衡
diagnostics.purpose: Record missingness, outlier handling, transformations, and treatment-control balance before interpreting estimates.
checks: standardized mean differences when treatment comparison is used
diagnostics.failure_action: Downgrade conclusions or rerun cleaning and balance checks before causal interpretation.

diagnostics.label: 测量效度
diagnostics.purpose: Confirm that variables, proxies, coding rules, and constructed indicators actually correspond to the theoretical concept.
diagnostics.failure_action: Mark the variable as provisional and avoid strong substantive interpretation.

diagnostics.label: 模型假设和设定诊断
diagnostics.purpose: Check model assumptions that matter for the selected family rather than running generic tests mechanically.
checks: multicollinearity when interpretation depends on coefficients
diagnostics.failure_action: Revise the model, change inference, or explicitly state the limitation.

diagnostics.label: 因果识别红线
diagnostics.purpose: Catch design-level weaknesses before writing causal claims or polishing the manuscript.
checks: placebo, pre-trend, density, weak-IV, overlap, or donor-pool diagnostics as applicable
old default methods flagged when modern replacements are required
diagnostics.failure_action: Block causal wording and return to identification_strategy_audit.

diagnostics.label: 推断、聚类和统计功效
diagnostics.purpose: Ensure uncertainty statements match the design, clusters, sample size, and precision limits.
checks: standard error or confidence interval type
precision and minimum detectable effect when relevant
diagnostics.failure_action: Report imprecision as a result boundary rather than a language problem.

robustness_ladder.label: 规格梯度
robustness_ladder.purpose: Show how estimates change as controls, fixed effects, samples, and inference choices are added.

robustness_ladder.label: 替代估计器
robustness_ladder.purpose: Use methodologically appropriate alternatives when a design has known fragile defaults.

robustness_ladder.label: 安慰剂和负控
robustness_ladder.purpose: Test whether the claimed design detects effects where it should not.

robustness_ladder.label: 异质性和机制
robustness_ladder.purpose: Separate subgroup variation, mechanism evidence, and exploratory patterns from the main causal claim.

robustness_ladder.label: 敏感性边界
robustness_ladder.purpose: Quantify how strong violations or hidden bias would need to be to overturn the main conclusion.

robustness_ladder.label: 发表级输出
robustness_ladder.purpose: Make empirical results readable, auditable, and aligned with text, figures, tables, and replication materials.
outputs: Stata/Python/R script-output map when code generated results

optional_artifacts: AER or AEJ venue fit note

safety_rules.rule: Do not write effect, impact, causes, or mechanism language unless the design family and identifying assumptions support it.
safety_rules.failure_action: Downgrade to association language or return to identification_strategy_audit.

safety_rules.rule: StatsPAI or any one-shot DSL can be used only when the inputs, estimand, estimator, diagnostics, and output scripts are recorded in auditable artifacts.
safety_rules.failure_action: Rerun through explicit Python, R, Stata, or documented pipeline code before formal delivery.

safety_rules.rule: Do not generate tables, figures, p-values, sample sizes, effect sizes, or robustness outcomes without real user-provided or verified data outputs.
safety_rules.failure_action: Return a template or analysis plan and ask for data or model outputs.

safety_rules.rule: Academic de-AI or humanization edits may only change wording, rhythm, and paragraph surface; facts, citations, variables, estimates, uncertainty, and limitations are locked.
safety_rules.failure_action: Reject the edit or produce a flagged diff for user confirmation.

safety_rules.rule: Do not promise to bypass Turnitin, CNKI AMLC, GPTZero, or any detector. The allowed objective is rigorous, authorial, non-template academic prose with traceable evidence.
safety_rules.failure_action: Reframe the task as writing-quality and academic-integrity cleanup.

safety_rules.rule: Empirical outputs, downloaded data, figures, and replication artifacts belong in the current project output tree, not in a shared global inbox, unless the task is an environment smoke test.
safety_rules.failure_action: Ask for or infer the project root before writing artifacts.

safety_rules.rule: AIGC, detector, or similarity numbers are not the local objective. The accepted objective is evidence-faithful, authorial academic prose with locked facts, citations, variables, estimates, uncertainty, and limitations.
safety_rules.failure_action: Reframe the request as academic writing-quality cleanup and report detector-related language as an external, non-guaranteed signal.

safety_rules.rule: When treatment timing is staggered, naive TWFE or a basic event-study regression cannot be the only DID evidence. Modern DID diagnostics or a justified non-causal downgrade are required.
safety_rules.failure_action: Return to identification_strategy_audit and add cohort, imputation, interaction-weighted, Bacon, or HonestDID checks as appropriate.

safety_rules.rule: Stata tables, figures, and estimates are not accepted as formal outputs unless the project records the do-file, command family, log, and output path that produced them.
safety_rules.failure_action: Ask for the do-file or produce a Stata pipeline scaffold before accepting the output into the manuscript or replication package.

safety_rules.rule: AER, AEJ, applied-microeconometrics, and economics-specific standards are conditional enhancement rules. They must not override local Chinese social-science, humanities, qualitative, descriptive, or project-specific standards when the task does not require them.
safety_rules.failure_action: Return to research-autopilot route selection and declare why the empirical-quant or economics-style standard is actually relevant before applying it.

safety_rules.rule: Stata support is enabled only when the project already uses Stata, collaborators or reviewers require Stata, a replication package needs .do files, or the user asks for Stata. Do not convert a Python, R, Excel, or supplied-output workflow to Stata by default.
safety_rules.failure_action: Keep the existing project tool chain and record Stata as optional rather than mandatory.

tool_ecosystems.label: Stata 计量与复现 do-file 生态
tool_ecosystems.use_when: Use only when the project already uses Stata, collaborators or reviewers require Stata, the replication package needs .do files, or the user asks for Stata-based applied microeconometrics output.
required_conventions: master script run_all.do controls the whole run order
every do-file starts with version declaration, set more off, set varabbrev off, and deterministic seed when random steps exist
paths are relative to project root; no personal C: or D: hardcoded paths in shareable scripts
00_globals.do declares input, intermediate, table, figure, log, and temp folders
logs are written for the full run and for major model stages
tables and figures are exported through traceable commands and mapped back to scripts
red_flags: only pasted Stata output without the command that produced it
hardcoded local paths in shareable scripts
manual table edits not recorded in the script-output map
package list copied from a template without checking the actual design family
TWFE event-study output delivered without modern DID diagnostics when treatment is staggered
switching a working Python, R, Excel, or supplied-output workflow into Stata without project need
